mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about World Wetlands Day 2026:
Statement A: It was observed on 2 February with the theme “Wetlands and traditional knowledge: Celebrating cultural heritage”.
Statement B: Its theme was “Pulses of the World: From Modesty to Excellence”.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is correct: World Wetlands Day 2026 was observed on 2 February with the theme “Wetlands and traditional knowledge: Celebrating cultural heritage”. Statement B is incorrect because “Pulses of the World: From Modesty to Excellence” was the theme of World Pulses Day, observed on 10 February.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): World Cancer Day is associated with the Paris Charter Against Cancer adopted at the World Cancer Summit on 4 February 2000.
Reason (R): The World Cancer Summit and the adoption of the Paris Charter Against Cancer took place on 4 February 2000.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Both the Assertion and the Reason are correct. World Cancer Day traces its origin to the Paris Charter Against Cancer from the World Cancer Summit held on 4 February 2000, and this event explains its association with the day.
